title: Adherence to and reasons for discontinuation of long-acting reversible contraception within Catalonia's access improvement plan
official: Evaluation of the plan to improve access to long-acting reversible contraception: adherence and reasons for discontinuation of LARCs
summary: Not provided at time of registration
conditions: Early (within a year) removal of long-acting contraceptives (copper IUD, implant)

interventions.name:
Recruitment: Midwives at ASSIR Dreta invite eligible users to take part when they decide to start a LARC under the Plan. After an explanation and signed informed consent, they enter the study.
Sample: About 375 participants (95% confidence, 5% margin of error). The protocol also plans to recruit ext

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Using a publicly funded copper IUD or implant through the Plan
2. Can answer in Catalan or Spanish
3. Autonomous
4. Signed consent
Exclusion criteria:
No internet access or unwilling to use it
sponsor: Institut Universitari d'Investigació en Atenció Primària Jordi Gol
